teacher_mapping.disposition: Generic computational reuse demonstrated conditionally; scientific qualification of independent study units remains open.
teacher_mapping.purpose: Conditionally reproduce average standardized IQ differences between expectancy-designated pupils and controls across the supplied historical packet. No IQ-point, causal or practice promise. [T1,T2]

effect.input: Keep all 19 supplied yi values, keyed by study ID. Positive means higher IQ in the expectancy-designated group; units are standard-deviation units, not IQ points. [T1,T2]
effect.derivation: The loader passes supplied yi/vi to escalc(measure="SMD", ni=n1i+n2i), removing sei. Do not apply a second bias correction or the writing formula. Exact primary-study standardization/correction is unspecified here. [T3]

variance.input: Use vi, not sei. All 19 are finite, positive and equal round(sei^2,4); exact squared sei differ by up to 0.000039. Preserve supplied rounding. [T1,CHECK]
variance.derivation: Arm IQ means/SDs needed to reconstruct effects/variances are absent. Explicit n1i/n2i are unequal in 14/19 rows; their sum is metadata, not support for an equal-arm approximation. [T1,T3,CHECK]

time.weeks: Weeks of teacher–student contact BEFORE expectancy induction; observed range 0–24. It is neither intervention length nor post-induction follow-up. [T2,CHECK]
time.model_role: Neither enters the intercept-only model. The documented weeks.c=min(weeks,3) moderator changes the model and requires separate qualification. [T4]

teacher_mapping.provenance: Raw .txt -> .r loader -> supplied SMD inputs. Documentation attributes data to Raudenbush & Bryk (1985), setting/tester to Raudenbush (1984). Author/year labels do not identify cohorts conclusively. Fresh sources govern the mapping. [T1,T2,T3,T4]

model.specification: yi=mu+ui+ei; independent ui~N(0,tau^2), ei~N(0,vi), vi treated as known. REML estimates tau^2>=0; wi=1/(vi+tau^2); mu=sum(wi*yi)/sum(wi); SE=sqrt(1/sum(wi)); 95% normal interval mu +/- 1.959963984540054*SE. This is neither a Hartung–Knapp nor prediction interval. [CODE]
model.estimand: Mean of the modeled distribution of study effects; not an individual-pupil mean, pooled raw IQ change, or estimate of a weeks effect.

conditional_execution.interpretation: Conditional quantitative reproduction; no causal, editorial or practice verdict

independence_and_ambiguities: There are 19 rows/studies, while the cited 1984 title says 18 experiments. Preserve the discrepancy pending source reconciliation; do not delete a row to force agreement. [T1,T2,T4]

Rows 4/5 share Pellegrini & Hicks (1972), weeks=0, group setting and n1i=11/n2i=22, but tester is aware/blind and yi/vi differ. Independence, duplication or repeated assessment cannot be decided from these labels. Obtain experiment/cohort IDs and outcome timing. [T1]

Verify shared pupils, controls, teachers/classrooms and repeated outcomes for all rows. Correlation requires covariance/design evidence and a qualified multivariate/cluster model or justified independent selection/aggregation; arbitrary deduplication is unwarranted.
Primary-study outcomes, SMD/variance derivations, cluster adjustments, eligibility and risk of bias remain unverified.

executable_checks.source_identity: fresh_mapping.json records original and normalized hashes. shlex preserves quoted authors; TSV retains cell strings, order and source row coordinates.
executable_checks.recovered_bytes: Archive SHA-256 matched daa27a2f32cd959757300c9df18be518166027729d549d46f1c422bed999223f. Actual recovered validator returned []; continuity.load_packet accepted 19 unique rows; continuity.reml produced the conditional result. [CHECK]
executable_checks.independent_reference: Independent analytic REML score root differences: tau^2=5.01e-10, estimate=4.35e-10, SE=3.12e-10; tolerance 1e-7 passed. Numerical agreement does not verify independence. [CHECK]
executable_checks.negative_controls: Recovered code flagged SMD relabeled kg/ha, flagged unsupported equal-arm variance, and rejected changed source bytes. Checks passed. [CHECK]

crop_disposition.disposition: The supplied notebook cannot substantiate a physical yield-improvement claim in kg/ha under the unchanged mapping. No crop estimate was fabricated or fitted.
concrete_blockers: The declared outcome is kg/ha, but pairwise sets sm="SMD". Input mean column units do not change the dimensionless output TE/seTE. Prose calling TE a mean difference cannot resolve this conflict. A pooled SMD cannot be relabeled kg/ha. [CR1,CR2]

The referenced data/yield_data.RDS is outside supplied permitted evidence. No arm means, SDs, sample sizes or verified TE/seTE table are provided. Column names and assertions of completeness are not measurements. [CR1,CR2]

Unresolved counts: 3 meta-analytical sources/3733 yield data; 3939 pairwise rows/3938 two-arm studies; later m=3732. Initial 11 sources/8814 data belong to a different screening stage. A row-level ledger must explain differences. [CR1,CR2]

The fitted model is a treatment network with Control reference. An intercept-only model cannot reproduce treatment-specific network effects or rankings; pooling all interventions needs a justified common target. [CR3]

Paired is defined only as intervention versus control, not verified matched observations. Meta-analyses may overlap primary trials; controls, sites, seasons or outcomes may be shared. IDs and covariances are missing. [CR1,CR2]

Control is described as best with 100% probability; verify ranking direction and numerical basis. Rankings do not quantify kg/ha gain. Heterogeneity/inconsistency assertions lack auditable fitted values. [CR4]
Resolve selstudy1, separated plot calls, the intended ID behavior of studylab="Source", and package versions before claiming reproducibility. Code repair alone does not create evidence. [CR2,CR3,CR4]
minimum_missing_evidence: Obtain exact yield_data.RDS or faithful hash-identified export, data dictionary/units, lawful access, a source-to-trial/arm/outcome ledger and exclusion log reconciling counts.

Agree the intervention/comparator, crop/population/site/season, harvest or follow-up time and benefit direction. Resolve whether the intended estimand is physical MD or standardized SMD before changing sm.

Supply treatment/control means in kg/ha, SDs, sample sizes and design, or validated MDs with variances in (kg/ha)^2. Independent arms: yi=mean_T-mean_C; vi=SD_T^2/n_T+SD_C^2/n_C. True pairs require pair counts and difference SD or correlation: vi=(SD_T^2+SD_C^2-2*r*SD_T*SD_C)/n. Cluster/shared-control designs need corresponding variance/covariance.
Verify independence or qualify dependence handling, eligibility and bias; provide a pinned executable environment, fitted estimates, uncertainty and relevant sensitivity analyses.

The same generic REML calculation can pool newly qualified independent MD rows in kg/ha for one accepted target. It cannot supply network rankings or causal field recommendations. Choosing an arbitrary SD to convert pooled SMD is invalid.
crop_disposition.stopping_condition: Hold the physical improvement claim until scale, source rows, study identities, design variances, target contrast and reproducible result are resolved. No statement here proves the interventions ineffective.

reusable_parts: Transfer the recovered method: bind purpose/population/units/sign/time, trace inputs, distinguish supplied/derived estimates, check variance prerequisites, retain ambiguity, and separate computation from substantive authority. [METHOD]
Transfer ingestion, source hashes, row identities, finite/positive checks, explicit derivation, REML optimization and its uncertainty convention after fresh mapping. [CODE,CHECK]

Writing uses yi=round((1-3/(4*ni-9))*di,2), vi=round((8+yi^2)/(2*ni),3), total ni and equal-arm approximation. Rechecked all 48 rows. This formula and treatment length in weeks remain source-specific. [B1,B2,CHECK]
Continuity correction scope, paired yi/vi updates and holds for overlap/ambiguous identities transfer. Simulated mission/rights booleans are not real authority. [CODE2]
fresh_obligations: Register a new teacher purpose, hashes, schema/mapping and exact model version; origin digest/acceptance cannot carry over automatically.
Reconcile 18 experiments/19 rows and rows 4/5 using primary evidence. Retain supplied rows only for conditional reconstruction meanwhile.
Before substantive inference verify independence, derivations, outcome comparability, bias and uncertainty; requalify covariance, model or moderator changes.

This task authorizes the completed local inspection/checks. Deployment, changed purpose, publication/editorial decisions, generalization and data-use rights need their own relevant authority/evidence.
Crop reuse requires the missing evidence and estimand decisions above. Validator success does not establish scientific acceptance.
